nodes.rationale: The three delegate-to-eager paths were deleted: (a) hadUndefinedLength non-SQ elements decode per-element via decodeWithEagerReadTag instead of throw-HARD→whole-file re-read; (b) deflate handled by seedReadContext's built-in pako inflater; (c) decision D-D resolved as 'propagate' — the tokenizer's parse error propagates directly because the empirical check showed no fixture relied on eager accepting what the tokenizer rejects. After J4, fromPart10 never re-reads the whole file.
